curriculum_framework: Union County Public Schools (NC) 7th Grade Standards

level_2_complex.description: Multi-step, fractions, decimals, exponents, or mixed representations

feedback_protocol.next_steps: Topic preview for the following day

agent_rules.benchmark_calculator_policy: No calculator unless explicitly allowed by the lesson
agent_rules.visual_support: Use visual explanations and interactive manipulatives when useful
agent_rules.session_management: Use 15/30/15 pacing as a target; understanding takes priority over speed
agent_rules.extra_practice: Parents may request more problems; preserve the same topic and gradually vary difficulty
